description: On-disk grant records: the kit.consent partition of <XDG_CONFIG_HOME>/kit/config.yaml. `version` must be 1; each grant carries exactly capability, subject, decision, duration (until or always), decided_at, expires_at (until only, after decided_at), decision_source and prompt_version. A store that breaks any rule is malformed as a whole, so every check fails closed. Grants are listed sorted by capability, then subject (byte order).

cases.name: file without a consent partition holds no grants
cases.config_yaml:
other: keep
kit:
  theme: dark

cases.name: empty grant list
cases.config_yaml:
kit:
  consent:
    version: 1
    grants: []

cases.name: grants come back sorted by capability then subject
cases.config_yaml:
kit:
  consent:
    version: 1
    grants:
      - capability: io.screen.capture
        subject: app:dek
        decision: allow
        duration: always
        decided_at: "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
        decision_source: prompt
        prompt_version: 1
      - capability: io.clipboard.read
        subject: app:dek
        decision: deny
        duration: always
        decided_at: "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
        decision_source: prompt
        prompt_version: 1
      - capability: io.clipboard.read
        subject: ""
        decision: allow
        duration: until
        decided_at: "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
        expires_at: "2026-03-02T00:00:00Z"
        decision_source: config
        prompt_version: 0

cases.name: telemetry block and grants partition are read together
cases.config_yaml:
kit:
  telemetry:
    consent:
      state: denied
      decided_at: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      prompt_version: 1
      decision_source: flag
  consent:
    version: 1
    grants:
      - capability: io.files.read
        subject: tool:kit
        decision: allow
        duration: always
        decided_at: "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
        decision_source: prompt
        prompt_version: 2
